BiblicalUsage: Proslepsis means a receiving, an admission back. It appears once, in Paul's great question about Israel: if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's question is a promise in disguise: if Israel's fall brought the world to God, their return will be nothing less than resurrection.
